subject: URGENT: finalize payment path — Invoice HZN-2145 (VAT recon needed)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Invoice HZN-2145 — payment path & VAT details

Hi Samantha,

Following up on Invoice HZN-2145 for $128,450.00 (due 11/30). AP flagged a VAT entity mismatch when they tried to route the payment and asked whether HorizonNet will pay the US entity (no VAT) or the EU subsidiary (VAT applicable).

Quick asks so we can push this into your next pay run: 
- Can you confirm the paying entity (US or EU)?
- If EU, can you share the VAT registration number your AP team needs?
- Would you prefer ACH, wire, or do you want to use your virtual card program? We can accept any of the three — wire is fastest for an out-of-cycle payment.

I’ve attached the invoice and our W-9/W-8 summary to speed verification. If wire is easiest, I can have our finance colleague send formal wire instructions.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Manager — Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@horizonnet.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2027 14:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice HZN-2145 — payment path & VAT details

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the note. Apologies for the delay — our AP runs twice monthly on the 1st and 15th. The invoice originally landed under HorizonNet Ltd. (EU) and that’s why the VAT field triggered a hold. I’m copying AP (ap@horizonnet.com) so they see this thread.

Short answers:
- Paying entity: HorizonNet Inc. (US) — our finance controller approved moving this to the US entity for this one-off settlement.
- VAT: Not applicable if the US entity pays.
- Payment method: We can do a same-day wire if Redwood can confirm wire instructions by EOD Monday; otherwise it will enter the 1/15 pay run (next scheduled).

If you send wired instructions and a remittance reference, we’ll route to expedited payment.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Head of Finance Operations — HorizonNet
samantha.lee@horizonnet.com
Cc: AP Team <ap@horizonnet.com>
